hypothesis: When BTCUSDT perpetual open interest expands unusually over 24 hours while price, funding, and realized volatility jointly indicate crowded long risk, the next eight-hour BTCUSDT return is negative enough for a fixed-horizon 1x short to retain positive expectancy after actual funding, taker fees, and modeled slippage.

data.metrics_source: Binance public data archive daily USD-M metrics with publisher SHA-256 checksums
data.locked_oos_rule: must not be evaluated unless every development gate passes

fixed_signal.open_interest_measure: sum_open_interest contracts, not notional open interest
fixed_signal.open_interest_threshold: greater than the shifted rolling 90th percentile of prior 365 days; minimum 180 days
fixed_signal.realized_volatility_threshold: greater than the shifted rolling median of prior 30 days
fixed_signal.entry: short at the first 5m candle open exactly five minutes after the decision timestamp

cost_model.funding: actual event rates during each position; positive funding is received by the short and negative funding is paid
cost_model.stop_gap_rule: if a 5m candle opens above the stop, cover at that open; otherwise cover at the stop; exit-side slippage and fee still apply

pre_result_data_amendments.sample_state: No development result was calculated. The loader stopped on the first archive before any signal, trade, or performance statistic was produced.
pre_result_data_amendments.observed_publisher_condition: The checksum-verified Binance archive contains byte-for-byte identical repeated CSV rows on 141 days and 598 absent five-minute timestamps across 66 days. No conflicting duplicate timestamps were observed in the acquired development archive.
pre_result_data_amendments.fixed_normalization_rule: Collapse only rows that are identical across every CSV field. Reject any timestamp whose repeated rows conflict, any timestamp outside its named UTC day, any off-grid timestamp, or any unexpected symbol.
pre_result_data_amendments.fixed_missing_data_rule: Reindex to the complete five-minute UTC grid without interpolation or forward/backward filling. Missing values remain NaN; any decision whose required feature window is incomplete is ineligible and cannot emit a signal.
pre_result_data_amendments.scope: Data-integrity normalization only. Signal conditions, feature windows, percentiles, execution delay, holding period, stop, cost assumptions, development dates, and gates are unchanged.

prohibited: changing feature windows, percentiles, stop, holding horizon, or costs after viewing development results
opening locked OOS when any development gate fails
using sum_open_interest_value because contemporaneous price mechanically changes notional open interest
forward-filling, backward-filling, or interpolating any missing 5m metrics observation
treating the research paper's classification result as evidence of executable trading profit
submitting live or test orders during this experiment
research_basis: Tran et al. (2026): realized volatility, open-interest changes, and cumulative funding predict eight-hour crypto crashes in panel tests
Alexander et al. (2023): exchange open-interest reporting can be inconsistent, so this experiment is Binance-specific and checksum-bound
Binance official public-data archive: daily USD-M metrics files and publisher checksums
